page.layout: Single page of running text with a head line (page number, running title, book and book number at top). Below the head line, one text block of paragraphs. Interspersed through the lower half are arithmetic computations laid out in three columns (left column, centre column, right column), followed by a small summary block of sums at the bottom left and right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: 12, ut sit 233, at 233 major est numerus quàm ut ex 196 subducatur, subtrahendus igitur ex 561, & reliquus sit dies 328 à Kal. Jan. quo annus Hegiræ 357 exiit, is est Nov. 24. Ergo annus Hegiræ 358 propositus incepit anno Christi 968 Nov. 25.

5. Tertium exemplum: Aljunabius, teste clarissimo doctissimóque nostro Edvardo Pocockio, & Leunclavius asserunt Constantinopolim à Muhammede Chano captam fuisse anno Hegiræ 857, Jomadæ prioris vigesimo, feriâ tertiâ. Examinemus cuinam anno Christi hic annus Hegiræ 857 respondeat.
main_text.l: Anni completi 856 Dies à Kal. Jan. 196

page.notes: The computation columns are set as printed; their exact alignment and some digits (e.g. "005", "4179") are approximate. The lower-left and lower-right blocks are transcribed as printed; the word "Ergo" at the end stands alone at the bottom right. Faint marks and the Google watermark at the lower right are omitted.
